body:
@shilman that bug has the same nature as https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/issues/6114, but can be fixed relatively easy. The root cause is that on story change, setOptions is called, and selectedPanel is changed, even though it is undefined in the options.

@airtonix do you plan to work on it by yourself? If not, I could help with that (I prepared a fix in local branch, but still need to add some tests).

issue.title: Fix #6077: issue with selectedPanel reset

repository.name: storybook
repository.description: Storybook is the industry standard workshop for building, documenting, and testing UI components in isolation

issue.body:
Issue: #6077 

## What I did
Added check for `options.selectedPanel` presence, so that if it is `undefined` it won't reset the currently selected panel.

## How to test
- Is this testable with Jest or Chromatic screenshots? **Yes, I added unit tests**
- Does this need a new example in the kitchen sink apps? **No**
- Does this need an update to the documentation? **No**

Ooh-la-la!! I just released https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/releases/tag/v5.1.0-alpha.11 containing PR #6149 that references this issue. Upgrade today to try it out!

I can reproduce it in `5.3.0-alpha.23`:

– Open https://storybookjs-next.now.sh/official-storybook/
– Switch to "Actions" panel
– Select some other story in the same kind

Panel resets to "Accessibility"

issue.title: Clicking a story in the storysource resets the addon panel

repository.name: storybook
repository.description: Storybook is the industry standard workshop for building, documenting, and testing UI components in isolation

issue.body: When you use the storysource addon and click a story inside it, you switch to that story, but the addon panel resets and you see the initial tab insteadof keeping the storysource addon panel open at the position it was.
